svg.text: 02 Deploy Infrastructure and Assets to Azure using Terraform | Architecture
Terraform deploys a static website to Azure Storage from main.tf and variables, and keeps its state file in a remote Azure Storage backend.
state file stored in the backend
The Azure CLI creates the state resource group, storage account, and private container.
variable.tf declares the inputs and dev.tfvars gives them values for main.tf.
terraform plan and apply create the website resources and index.html in $web.
Terraform keeps terraform.tfstate in tfstatecon; terraform destroy removes it all.
Azure resource holds the next one
Command or traffic from your workstation
